title: Build independently signed CCP2 wire fixtures
description:
Scope: a focused CCP2 wire fixture family and independent encoder/check path in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/. Reference /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/reference_schnorr48.py only for independently checked signing/transcript primitives, not its legacy SHA-512 address constructor. Construct exact schedule, commitment, grant and capability bytes/signatures plus malformed, substitution, wrong-authority and mixed-version cases. Root/DODAG identities use pinned upstream Yggdrasil literals. Do not generate expectations with production codecs or require rewriting the broad legacy generator.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.

Decomposition review scope: Produce independent encoded and signed directional observation-report fixtures from the wire.07/wire.09 contract, including positive fields/units and malformed, wrong-owner/direction, stale-generation and signature-mutation cases. Semantic observation traces in vectors.07 are supplementary, not a substitute for these wire bytes.
design: Keep the encoder small and isolated from production imports; extend an existing suitable oracle entry point or add one focused family generator only when needed. Round trips and cross-language agreement are not the expected-value oracle.
acceptance_criteria:
Committed fixtures contain exact input bytes, covered transcript, signature, independent expected interpretation/rejection and provenance for every wire object type. Independent encoding and reference-signature checks reproduce positives; bad signatures, wrong contexts, duplicate/unknown fields, length errors and incompatible revisions have specified negatives. Generation/checking is deterministic and touches only selected CCP2 artifacts. No production identity helper supplies expected routable addresses and no legacy fixture outputs are rewritten.

Additional required acceptance: The frozen wire corpus contains independently generated directional-report bytes/transcripts and negatives consumed by the production signaling tests; no report format is invented by a language implementation.
notes: Task-definition amendment after independent decomposition review. This commissions future work only; nothing was implemented or tested. The initial CLI-input fingerprint is retained as initial_scope_sha256; current native Beads fields are authoritative. Do not rerun the seed applicator over this reviewed amendment.
